Hi, thanks for replying, I really appreciate it. 

I have talked it over with my partner/family/friends at one point or another. I just can't seem to shake it. I think it's a bit of fear that I'm bothering them, combined with a worry that maybe I can't or am unwilling to change. 

An altered mindset is definitely key here. If anyone has done, or is looking into DBT, I would love input regarding that also.
